```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

project_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Downloads", "AC_combined_analysis", "Adriana_analysis")
tables_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "output_tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(gprofiler2)

# gprofiler2 doesn't clash with dplyr::select, but pin it anyway
# as a precaution if other annotation packages get loaded later
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r load-data}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCA_genes_AC.txt: gene-level PC scores
# Only PC1/PC2 carry meaningful biological signal (PC4+ is
# noise-level flat variance, confirmed by diagnostic script)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE)

pca_genes_long <- pca_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(PC1, PC2), names_to = "PC", values_to = "score")

all_genes_universe <- pca_genes$gene_id
```

```{r filter-top-bottom-10pct}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Top/bottom 10% of PC1 and PC2 separately, matching
# Adriana's original approach and script 01 (clusterProfiler)
# so results are directly comparable across methods
# ---------------------------------------------------------
get_top_bottom_10pct <- function(df, pc_name) {
  df_pc <- df %>% filter(PC == pc_name)
  n <- nrow(df_pc)
  cutoff_n <- ceiling(n * 0.1)

  top    <- df_pc %>% slice_max(score, n = cutoff_n) %>% pull(gene_id)
  bottom <- df_pc %>% slice_min(score, n = cutoff_n) %>% pull(gene_id)

  list(top = top, bottom = bottom)
}

pc1_genes <- get_top_bottom_10pct(pca_genes_long, "PC1")
pc2_genes <- get_top_bottom_10pct(pca_genes_long, "PC2")

cat("PC1 top 10%:", length(pc1_genes$top), "genes | bottom 10%:", length(pc1_genes$bottom), "genes\n")
cat("PC2 top 10%:", length(pc2_genes$top), "genes | bottom 10%:", length(pc2_genes$bottom), "genes\n")
```

```{r run-enrichment-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# gProfiler wrapper
# Key difference from clusterProfiler: gProfiler separates
# results by BP (biological process), MF (molecular function),
# and CC (cellular component) automatically via the 'sources'
# argument. organism = "scerevisiae" uses gProfiler's built-in
# S. cerevisiae annotation (no local OrgDb needed).
# custom_bg sets the universe to our PCA gene list, matching
# the universe used in script 01.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_gprofiler <- function(gene_list, universe, label) {
  result <- gost(
    query        = gene_list,
    organism     = "scerevisiae",
    sources      = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"),
    custom_bg    = universe,
    correction_method = "fdr",
    user_threshold    = 0.05,
    significant  = TRUE
  )

  if (is.null(result)) {
    cat(label, "- no significant terms found\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- result$result
  cat(label, "-", nrow(df), "enriched terms\n")
  cat("  BP:", sum(df$source == "GO:BP"),
      "| MF:", sum(df$source == "GO:MF"),
      "| CC:", sum(df$source == "GO:CC"), "\n")
  df
}
```

```{r run-all}
gp_pc1_top    <- run_gprofiler(pc1_genes$top,    all_genes_universe, "PC1 top 10%")
gp_pc1_bottom <- run_gprofiler(pc1_genes$bottom, all_genes_universe, "PC1 bottom 10%")
gp_pc2_top    <- run_gprofiler(pc2_genes$top,    all_genes_universe, "PC2 top 10%")
gp_pc2_bottom <- run_gprofiler(pc2_genes$bottom, all_genes_universe, "PC2 bottom 10%")
```

```{r plot-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Top 20 terms per GO namespace (BP/MF/CC separately),
# matching the BP/MF/CC split Adriana described in the meeting.
# Long term names truncated/wrapped as per script 01 fix.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_gprofiler_top20 <- function(df, title) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No enriched terms for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_top20 <- df %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 20) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Description_short = if_else(
        nchar(term_name) > 60,
        str_trunc(term_name, 60, ellipsis = "..."),
        term_name
      ),
      Description_short = str_wrap(Description_short, width = 40),
      Description_short = fct_reorder(Description_short, -log10(p_value)),
      neg_log10_p = -log10(p_value),
      source = factor(source, levels = c("GO:BP", "GO:MF", "GO:CC"))
    )

  ggplot(df_top20, aes(x = neg_log10_p, y = Description_short,
                       size = intersection_size, color = source)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~source, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("GO:BP" = "#4393c3",
                                   "GO:MF" = "#d6604d",
                                   "GO:CC" = "#74c476")) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(-log[10]("p-value")),
      y = NULL,
      size = "Intersection\nsize",
      color = "Namespace"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
      strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r plot-pc1, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
plot_gprofiler_top20(gp_pc1_top,    "PC1 top 10% - GO enrichment (gProfiler)")
plot_gprofiler_top20(gp_pc1_bottom, "PC1 bottom 10% - GO enrichment (gProfiler)")
```

```{r plot-pc2, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
plot_gprofiler_top20(gp_pc2_top,    "PC2 top 10% - GO enrichment (gProfiler)")
plot_gprofiler_top20(gp_pc2_bottom, "PC2 bottom 10% - GO enrichment (gProfiler)")
```

```{r save-outputs}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Save results tables and figures
# NULL check guards against any PC with no significant terms
# ---------------------------------------------------------
save_if_not_null <- function(df, path) {
  if (!is.null(df)) write_tsv(df, path)
}

save_if_not_null(gp_pc1_top,    file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc1_top10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc1_bottom, file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc1_bottom10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc2_top,    file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc2_top10pct.txt"))
save_if_not_null(gp_pc2_bottom, file.path(output_dir, "go_gprofiler_pc2_bottom10pct.txt"))

plot_list <- list(
  pc1_top    = gp_pc1_top,
  pc1_bottom = gp_pc1_bottom,
  pc2_top    = gp_pc2_top,
  pc2_bottom = gp_pc2_bottom
)

for (pc_label in names(plot_list)) {
  p <- plot_gprofiler_top20(
    plot_list[[pc_label]],
    paste(toupper(pc_label), "- GO enrichment (gProfiler)")
  )
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(figures_dir, paste0("go_gprofiler_", pc_label, "10pct.png")),
      plot = p, width = 10, height = 14
    )
  }
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
